I present you: 

iPhone 18 Pro Fold ❤️

Okay this one's pretty good, I uploaded a clip of my voice, and a few pics, and this came out, it's getting close to passable!

Live on Photo AI now 😊

replies.text: This reminds me of all the fake videos 10 years ago with wild speculation of what the next iPhone was going to be.
replies.author: @North_Range

replies.text: The gap between “cool demo” and “actually usable” is closing fast—voice + pics as input is the right direction.
replies.author: @henryhndev

replies.text: The way it stitched the voice sample into that foldable mockup feels almost ready for real product leaks, though the hinge animation still gives it away a little if you look close.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: It doesn’t have a label. - EU AI Act. 😅
replies.author: @InfosecMinion

replies.text:
Impressive

But still not better than this wholesome and relatable review.

Models are really good in short bursts for cut scene, but to make a whole 30 min review.

You're better off doing the real thing.
replies.author: @dherealmark

decoy_rationale: The reply is oddly balanced with mild praise plus a hedged nitpick, giving it a slightly too-polished explanatory tone.
